_note: Fictional example rules for the demo persona (Mark Callahan, Columbus OH, third-party logistics operations). Copy to your own rules file and change every value.

_comment.pay.floor: The pay floor. A role whose EMPLOYER-stated top of range is below this is dropped.
_comment.pay.target: Top of the flagged band. Employer pay at or above the floor but below this is kept, with the note 'below target pay', so a human sees it.
_comment.pay.estimate_floor: The skip line for a listing site's ESTIMATED pay. Estimates are often wrong, so this sits below the floor and drops only the clearly hopeless.
_comment.location.allow_remote: If true, remote roles pass the location rule wherever the employer is.
_comment.location.local_cities: The commute radius around home, as the towns inside it. Lowercase substrings matched against the listing's location; include the state so a same-named town elsewhere does not match. An unknown location ('3 Locations') always passes.
_comment.location.local_state: Home state, for the Researcher and Fit Judge (the screener itself does not use it).
_comment.skip_companies: Ad and gig 'employers' to drop outright (lowercase; matches the whole name or its first words).
_comment.skip_title_patterns: Regexes (on the lowercased title) for functions that are never a fit. Matched titles are dropped.
_comment.skip_ic_title_patterns: Regexes for individual-contributor or entry-level titles. Dropped only when the title has no target- or stretch-level word.
_comment.apply_override_patterns: Optional. Titles labelled the target level even though they contain a stretch-level phrase (checked first). Empty in this example; add patterns if a title at your target level contains a stretch-level word.
_comment.stretch_title_patterns: The stretch level: titles labelled 'stretch'. A label, never a drop.
_comment.apply_title_patterns: The target level: titles labelled 'apply'. Anything matching neither list is 'unclear' and still goes forward.
_comment.dedupe_days: A listing already given a verdict within this many days is dropped as 'already judged'.
_comment.package_alarm: Used by the run orchestration, not the screener: if more roles than this would get a tailored package in one run, build the top ones and list the rest in the report.
